system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Guile and Intimidation, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Debt Law Lore, Moneylending Lore, Local Business Lore.
system.description: You recovered money from people who had learned to avoid answering their doors. A convincing bluff and a carefully judged threat often did more for you than an honest request.
